## v0.5.11 · Quiet Windows Git Branch Detection

[#260](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/260) fixes [#259](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/issues/259): Runtime Git branch probes hide their Windows console, preventing brief terminal windows in GUI hosts. Branch filtering, the two-second timeout and failure fallback are unchanged.

### Packages and upgrade

New publications: **dsh-mnemon 0.5.11** and **Runtime Source 0.5.8**. The other fifteen plugins retain their versions; configuration and memory data need no migration.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.11
```

Restart DSH and reload the browser; use `headless` for that Profile. Mnemon CLI remains independently maintained.

### 中文说明

本版修复 Windows GUI 宿主查询 Git 分支时短暂弹出终端窗口的问题。Runtime 查询增加隐藏窗口选项，保留分支过滤、两秒超时和失败回退。主包发布 0.5.11，Runtime Source 发布 0.5.8，其余十五个插件不变，无需迁移配置或已有记忆。升级后重启 DSH 并刷新浏览器。

Four real Windows trials observed 104–105 visible windows per baseline trial and zero after the fix. The implementation passed 59 Runtime tests, 1,162 root tests, real CLI/macOS WebUI checks and independent plugin composition. [Before/after evidence](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.11/docs/pr-assets/issue-259-windows-git-console/README.md) distinguishes Windows process observation from macOS WebUI validation. The release workflow checks versioned artifacts, Registry composition and an actual upgrade before creating this Release.

See [English release notes](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.11/docs/en/releases/v0.5.11.md) and [中文发布说明](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.11/docs/zh-CN/releases/v0.5.11.md).
